title_en: The Legitimacy of Seeking Intercession through the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in His Life and After His Death, Episode 9
description_en: Selections on the stations of the Chosen One (peace be upon him and his family), episode 13, The legitimacy of seeking intercession through the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in his life and after his death, part 9, from the program Debates in Creed by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure).
summary: This lecture explores the topic of seeking intercession through the Prophet Muhammad within the Debates in Creed program.
series_en: Debates in Creed - Selections on the Stations of the Chosen One
